routes.name: Credit-facility paired maturity extension, relative downside
routes.mechanism: Refinancing-runway / liquidity insurance; a maturity extension pushes out the rollover calendar. Relative downside expressible via protective put or collar; not rejected for negative direction.
routes.endpoint: count of explicit paired maturity changes in a bounded subsample, then conditional paired event-minus-ordinary payoff
routes.steelman: Refinancing-runway risk is a genuine downside channel even for an undrawn facility; the pilot shows measurement is exactly verifiable and cleanly separates verified change from unknown; a bounded amendment-exhibit screen would convert UNKNOWN clean renewals into a measured count and is a legitimate classifier-free contribution even if the economic result is null.
routes.strongest_failure_case: Disclosure structure rarely recites both dates, so the screen may again find almost no pairs (a source failure, not a mechanism test); the audited pilot yield is already low (1/12 maturity, 0/12 capacity). Even if pairs are found, mega-cap issuers are rarely funding-constrained and an undrawn revolver does not remove operating risk, so the usable economic sample may be below any defensible floor. The 2022-2023 block is outside the authorized contestant financial study ('do not move them earlier'), independent of any provider availability question.

routes.name: Option-implied uncertainty calibration / hedging utility
routes.basis: market-derived numerical endpoint using existing fields; cohort defined by a single taxonomy tag
routes.mechanism: Options are event insurance; test whether event option-implied uncertainty is miscalibrated relative to matched ordinary days and whether that is capturable as hedging utility rather than greatest mean P&L.
routes.endpoint: paired event-minus-ordinary mean net value of a predeclared 5% OTM protective-put hedge leg at one horizon/bucket, valued by mark-to-market

hedge_leg_definition.formula: H_i = protective_put_i - stock_i = (P_L_exit - P_L_entry) / S_entry, plus frozen modeled commission, funding and premium haircut
hedge_leg_definition.intrinsic_valid_only_at: expiration; used only for the reported exp horizon

routes.steelman: The repository already computed implied and realized movement for every event and control; reframing the endpoint from greatest mean P&L to whether event insurance is mispriced makes the failed movement gate informative, uses no new classifier or feed, and yields a rubric-competitive result whether the sign is positive or negative; relative downside value remains expressible via a protective put or collar.
routes.strongest_failure_case: At horizon 5 events moved more than ordinary days on an absolute basis, so event insurance was not obviously overpriced; the implied move is a crude straddle proxy, not model-free IV, and inherits documented entry-timing, contamination, BLK-cluster and strict-mark defects; a +0.158 difference in a 54-event cell with no interval is a hypothesis, not a result; reusing the earnings cohort is exposed exploration and a fresh tag cohort may be too small.
routes.failure_class_if_null: financial (interval contains zero = mispricing result) versus source (too small to price = source failure); reported separately
unknowns: power of a 62-filing tag cohort after strict marks
whether hedge-leg value differs from zero

routes.name: Equity-issuance / dilution tag, relative downside
routes.mechanism: Dilution plus adverse-selection drift predicts negative short-horizon drift; relative downside expressible via protective put or collar. Blanket sign rejection does not apply.
routes.endpoint: paired event-minus-ordinary payoff for a predeclared relative-downside structure
routes.authorized_window_note: Authorized financial window is 2024-2025 ('do not move them earlier'); earlier marks are outside the authorized contestant financial study, not merely unvalidated.
routes.steelman: A negative-sign mechanism is an unexploited corner of a long-or-neutral library and the correction recorded in section 2 preserves protective-put and collar value; dilution and adverse selection are clean, well-motivated economics, and the tag is numerical and classifier-free.
routes.strongest_failure_case: The tag counts are unverified keyword proxies (219 hits / 62 issuers) and may be dominated by shelf registrations rather than actual issuance; SEO drift is among the most studied effects and is likely priced; a small drift is easily eaten by option premium and spreads in the mega-cap universe.
routes.failure_class_if_null: source (unverified or small cohort) versus financial null (interval contains zero); reported separately

primary_endpoint.name: paired event-minus-ordinary mean net value of a predeclared 5% OTM protective-put hedge leg
primary_endpoint.formula: H_i = protective_put_i - stock_i = (P_L_exit - P_L_entry) / S_entry, plus frozen modeled commission, funding and premium haircut
primary_endpoint.valuation: mark-to-market from entry mark to exit mark on the same source; the expiration intrinsic max(K - S_exit, 0) - P_entry is not used because the option is held 5 sessions with a 3-6 month expiry and intrinsic is valid only at expiration
primary_endpoint.inference: company-cluster bootstrap interval on mean(H_event - H_ordinary)
primary_endpoint.sidedness: two-sided; no direction asserted as guaranteed
primary_endpoint.secondary_consistency_check: calibration residual |realized| - implied_move*sqrt(h/DTE) must agree in sign; disagreement reported as inconsistent; the residual is an assumption-dependent straddle-sqrt-time proxy, not a guaranteed-unbiased estimator or true annualized IV

recommended_next_step.matched_ordinary_day_baseline: same issuer, same calendar year, predeclared gap from any same-tag event, up to three controls per event, hash-ordered and frozen before pricing
